description: Machine-readable companion to SETUP.md. An agent can walk this top to bottom: probes, then secrets it must ask a human for, then steps, then checks.
agent_rules: Never print TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, or any value marked secret, into the transcript, a log, or a diff.
Never edit a start script to add a Node or Codex path; use the documented environment overrides.
Never widen CODEX_SANDBOX_MODE to unblock a failing command without asking the human first.
Ask the human to run `codex login` themselves; it opens a browser.

probes.fail: Native Windows is unsupported. Use WSL2.
Checkout is on a Windows drive mount. DrvFs does not enforce the socket permission bits that are this system's only access control, and breaks SQLite WAL. Move to the Linux filesystem.
Install Node >= 22, or set TELECODEX_NODE_BIN. Do not edit scripts.
npm is needed by telecodex.setup.sh and by the Codex pin.

probes.degrades_to: Block-LaTeX images are skipped; text delivery is unaffected. Two tests in test/latex-renderer.test.ts do fail without it.
Socket liveness uses a Node connect probe instead; Codex Desktop relay detection (macOS only) stays off.

secrets_from_human.obtain: The human messages @BotFather on Telegram with /newbot and pastes the token back.
secrets_from_human.blast_radius: Holding this token means reading every message the chat has ever carried and posting as the bot. It does not by itself allow code execution: from.id cannot be forged, so the allowlist still stands.

secrets_from_human.obtain: Numeric Telegram user ids, comma separated. The human gets theirs from @userinfobot. Usernames are not accepted.
secrets_from_human.blast_radius: This list is the only authentication in the system. Everyone on it can do anything Codex can do on this host. Confirm every digit with the human.

env.advice: The only meaningful containment in the system. Do not widen it to unblock a command.
never is deliberate: the bridge has no approval UI, so any other value stalls turns instead of gating them.
app-server is the shared-writer architecture the start scripts and TELECODEX.md describe.
Lowercase. Also the profiles/<botKey>/ directory name and the worker argument.
all-authorized is not a bypass; it runs after the allowlist check.
Set only when automatic Node resolution picks the wrong interpreter.
Set to an existing Codex CLI to skip the repo-local pin. Must be exported for every TeleCodex process, so put it in .telecodex.env.
Only for API-key auth. The default is the host's existing `codex login` session.

steps.then: Fill in the two values from secrets_from_human. Do not echo them.
Write profiles/$BOT_KEY/profile.json with default_workspace set to the directory the human named. Without it, the bot's workspace is this repository. See profiles/example/.

steps.on_failure: Ask the human to run `codex login`. Do not drive the browser flow.

steps.then: Three separate long-lived processes. Ask the human to message the bot; a reply means it works.
Renders systemd user units or launchd agents into .telecodex/deploy/ and prints the install commands. It does not install or load anything.

verify.run: git status --porcelain --ignored | grep -E '\.telecodex\.env$|^\?\? \.telecodex/' >/dev/null; git ls-files | grep -E '\.telecodex\.env$' && echo LEAK || true
